title: bst-markov_ui-and-agg-artificial/1 parameter file
description: One member of the Markov family's artificial version (constraint-scenarios.md): the laws' floors strictly positive, so that every state's natural limit lies below zero, and an artificial constraint tighter than the lowest of them. Draft.
$comment: This validator checks names, types and ranges. The checker checks the rest: the shared rules (shares, the order of the types, two quarters of benefits, each law's own rules, the validity conditions of conditions.md) and the version's: psi and theta with strictly positive floors, and a_Art strictly above the lowest natural limit.
